as_told.title: STS-48 and STS-80 space shuttle cases

plain: Two space shuttle missions, known by their NASA flight codes STS-48 in 1991 and STS-80 in 1996, are said to have filmed unexplained objects in orbit around Earth. NASA is the US space agency, and these objects are what officials now call UAP, unidentified anomalous phenomena. A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani brings up both videos as key cases, and another guest, Max, refers back to them in passing. They are told as evidence that strange objects may have been caught on camera in space.
